claims.statement: The Northgate Business Park lease requires the tenant to reimburse its pro rata share of operating expenses and real estate taxes on a triple-net basis, subject to a controllable-expense cap of 5% per annum, applied on a cumulative, compounding basis.

citations.quote: Tenant reimburses its pro rata share of operating expenses and real estate taxes on a triple-net basis, subject to a controllable-expense cap of 5% per annum on a cumulative, compounding basis.
